issue.title: Split ~/bob/sase.md into child projects with a new bob task move
issue.description: The ~/bob/sase.md hub is migrated to the research report's recommended split. Duplicates are merged, stale ideas are removed, and routed tasks live in their child notes with every id, dependency, Task Link, and backlink intact. The moves use a tested `bob task move` command that preserves freshness and keeps the vault synced.
